messages.text: Ok, let's assume this is the common readout module - can you go on and design a Barrel and Endcap HCAL accordingly (separate PRs) please

I’ll use the common module as the working basis for separate barrel and endcap designs. I’ll check the current envelope and interface constraints, develop both as isolated prototypes, and put each in its own PR with drawings and validation evidence.

I’m applying the repository’s coordination, design-evidence and review procedures. PR #81 is still open and its checks passed, so I’ll make the barrel and endcap PRs sibling branches based on it. Each will show only its regional design changes.

The common carrier exposes a depth mismatch: 36 layers of 30 mm steel, 12 mm carriers and 1 mm installation gaps, plus a 10 mm back cover, need 1.558 m—62.1 mm beyond the current outline. I’ll propose that enlargement explicitly in both designs and retain the sampling stack as a comparison baseline; containment still needs shower studies.

The first packing results show why area and directional sampling need separate checks: unchanged paired carriers have a 69.64% tile-core area ceiling before assembly gaps. The barrel design will stagger seams with matched carrier counts. For the endcaps, I’m using broad quadrant layers and aperture-adaptive rows, which bring intact carriers closer to the bore than narrow 16-sector wedges.

Both implementations passed independent review and their regional tests: 15 barrel controls and 19 endcap controls. The reviewer also checked 3,105 global tile-edge probes per region with no lookup discrepancies. The proposals will keep the remaining limits visible: sector cracks, partial transition depth, and no endcap HCAL coverage at η = 4.

The drawings and regional reports are complete, including the 62.1 mm depth amendment and explicit service boundaries. The conditional local heat budgets are about 326 kW for the barrel and 202 kW for both endcaps, so regional power distribution and cooling are substantial follow-up work. I’m checking the final records before publishing the two PRs.

Created the separate draft PRs: [barrel #84](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/84) and [endcaps #85](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/85). Both are based on the common-module PR #81. I’m finishing the cross-links and tracking records; local checks pass, and hosted validation is running.

Created separate draft PRs:

- [Barrel HCAL — #84](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/84): 16 sectors, 36 layers and staggered 33-row packing.
- [Endcap HCAL — #85](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/85): aperture-adaptive quadrant packing with rotated layer patterns.

Both depend on common-module PR #81 and include drawings, material/power budgets, sampling maps and independent review. Local checks pass; hosted CI is pending.

Both propose **62.1 mm additional depth**. Residual cracks, forward handover and collector connections remain explicit review items.
